fusions.name: Snapped at the Entrance
fusions.desc: Snaps up the first enemy within 3 tiles for 4 damage, then the next 2 within 3 tiles for 60% of that. You heal for 30% of the damage dealt.

fusions.name: Smoke the Hive
fusions.desc: Blows a cone of musk-smoke 4 tiles long, dealing 26 damage to everything in it and leaving it [Hindered] for 8 seconds. When it hits, you and your allies deal 15% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Scratch at the Comb
fusions.desc: Scratches a hive open. For 12 seconds its swarm stings an enemy within 4 tiles for 3 damage every second, and each kill restores 4 health to you.

fusions.name: Steady Industry
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 6% sooner. Your armour rises by 8%.
